text: The relationship between total cost (Y axis) and total activity (X axis) for the four cost behavior patterns is mathematically expressed as follows: Total variable cost = variable cost per unit x activity The variable cost per unit is referred to as the slope of the cost function. Fixed cost = total fixed costs The slope of the fixed cost function is zero because fixed costs do not change with activity. Total mixed cost = total fixed cost + (variable cost per unit x activity) Step cost = total fixed cost within a specific range of activity
